company: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited

kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 82 (RHP; NSE issue page). At Rs 82: 2.23 crore new shares, 6.28 crore post-issue; market cap Rs 515.2 cr; P/E 16.9x FY26 EPS post-issue (10.7x pre-issue; 13.2x pro forma for interest saved); P/B 1.61x; EV/EBITDA 7.0x. Oct-2025 private placement was at Rs 88.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow Rs 11.49 / 32.09 / 10.22 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 21.14 / 28.67 / 30.54 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT 67.0% while revenue grew 30% a year and inventory rose Rs 73.6 cr in FY26. Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 72.31 cr (PAT Rs 15.08 cr) as inventory was released.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Promoters and relatives lend the company Rs 20.55 cr (Jun-26) at interest (Rs 3.08 cr in FY26) and rent it premises (Rs 0.52 cr in FY26); managerial pay Rs 0.66 cr to three promoter directors in FY26. Disclosed and typical of a promoter-funded company.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: JSW Steel Coated Products supplied 86.65% of FY26 steel coils (85.13% in Q1 FY27); appliances 86.54% of FY26 product revenue; top customer (Amber Enterprises) 20.40% and top-10 71.33% of FY26 revenue. Typical of a service centre tied to one mill and the appliance PLI ecosystem.

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: 25 delayed RoC filings over five years and a 2021 allotment to a promoter filed with the wrong form; adjudication application (06-Jan-2026) still pending before the RoC. Procedural; no penalty yet.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -68.8% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

adjustments.item: Continuous Production Scheme benefit, other income and gain on derecognition
adjustments.reason: One-off Continuous Production Scheme benefit Rs 1.95 cr (FY24); gain on derecognition Rs 0.09 cr and other income Rs 0.03 cr (FY26).
Insurance claims Rs 0.11 cr (FY24) and Rs 0.55 cr (FY25); non-recurring.

adjustments.item: Assets written off and loss on sale of PPE (one-off charges)
adjustments.reason: Assets written off Rs 0.47 cr and loss on sale Rs 0.03 cr in FY26; one-off charges, added back so the test stays two-sided.
Mostly on margin-money deposits backing letters of credit for coil purchases, so tied to operations. Shown for information.

adjustments.item: Pro-forma interest saving on Rs 125 cr of debt repaid from the issue (at about 9%)
adjustments.reason: Not an accounting adjustment: the earnings after the issue repays Rs 125 cr of borrowings. For information.
